 Liev Schreiber Chastises Reporter on Red Carpet, Video
 Liev Schreiber 
 Rips Into Reporter ... 
 Treat People Like You Value What They Do!!! 
 Exclusive Details 
 Add TMZ on Google 
 By TMZ Staff 
 Published 
 October 21, 2026
 10:32 AM PDT 
 | 
 Updated 
 October 21, 2026
 12:28 PM PDT 
 Play video content 
 LIEV GOES OFF 
 Video: Liev Schreiber Calls Out Apple Reporter on Red Carpet 
 BACKGRID 
 Liev Schreiber got into a heated exchange with a reporter on the red carpet ... a bizarre occurrence -- especially because the two are apparently playing for the same team.
 The actor attended the premiere of his new Apple TV+ show "Nocturne" in New York City Tuesday night ... when a reporter asked him a question for which he apparently didn't care.
 Check out the clip ... it seems Liev's not happy that the reporter seems to be chasing after social media views to cultivate engagement -- telling her she needs to treat people like she values what they do.
 He also adds something strange ... telling the reporter it shouldn't be a "f***ing soundbite" -- especially when it's being done "in-house."
 The reporter handles it well ... keeping a smile on her face, trying to make jokes and -- ultimately -- coming up with a topic Liev seems happy with, and the pair apparently got on with the interview.
 Getty 
 Witnesses tell us ...  Liev was clearly just passionate about "Nocturne" -- and he didn't like the questions the correspondent was asking. They also note things ended amicably, and everyone walked away happy.
 We've reached out to Liev and Apple for more info about what happened here ... so far, no word back.
